```{r, include=FALSE}
# output directories
dir_check_summary <- file.path(currentdir, "summary")

fn_cor_summary <- paste0(fn_prefix, ".cor.sumtable")
fn_cor_summary_trimal <- paste0(fn_prefix, ".cor_trimal.sumtable")

```

```{r}
# extract list of locus
ls_locus <- list.dirs(params$dir_genes_alignment, recursive=F, full.names=F)

# print the number of locus in HTML document
cat(paste("Number of gene trees:", length(ls_locus)))

# check if list is of length zero
if (length(ls_locus) == 0) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Error: list of locus is of length zero. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}

# extract list of prefix from the first locus
temp_tre <- file.path(params$dir_genes_alignment, ls_locus[1], paste0(ls_locus[1], ".treefile"))
temp_tre <- ape::read.tree(temp_tre)
ls_prefix <- temp_tre$tip.label[grepl("--",temp_tre$tip.label)]

# print the number of prefix in HTML document
cat(paste("Number of mapped reads:", length(ls_prefix)))

# check if list is of length zero
if (length(ls_prefix) == 0) {
    log4r::error(fn_logger, "Error: list of mapped reads is of length zero. Exited.")
    knitr::knit_exit()
}

# extract list of reference sequences and short-reads
ls_refseq <- unique(sapply(ls_prefix, function(x) { unlist(strsplit(x, split="--"))[2] }))
ls_shortreads <- unique(sapply(ls_prefix, function(x) { unlist(strsplit(x, split="--"))[1] }))
```

## Calculate phylogenetic distance between mapped reads and reference from the same taxon
```{r summary-individual}
# set up variable
is_check_summary_individual <- FALSE
plot <- NULL

# check species overlaps
ls_intersect_sp <- intersect(ls_refseq, ls_shortreads)

# iterate over overlaps
if (length(ls_intersect_sp) > 0) {
    # update variable
    is_check_summary_individual <- TRUE

    # create doSNOW cluster
    nwcl <- makeCluster(params$thread)
    doSNOW::registerDoSNOW(nwcl)

    # iterate over loci
    ls_output <- foreach (locus = ls_locus, .combine='c') %dopar% {
        # read tree
        tre <- ape::read.tree(file.path(params$dir_genes_alignment, locus, paste0(locus, ".treefile")))
        ls_tips <- tre$tip.label

        # calculate phylogenetic distance
        distance_tre <- ape::cophenetic.phylo(tre)

        # iterate over reads
        ls_dist <- c()
        for (sp in ls_intersect_sp) {
            ls_dist <- c(ls_dist, distance_tre[rownames(distance_tre)==paste0(sp,"--",sp),
                                               colnames(distance_tre)==sp])
        }
        
        return(ls_dist)
    }

    stopCluster(nwcl)

    # visualisation
    plot <- ggplot(data.frame(ls_output), aes(x=ls_output, xmin=0, xmax=max(ls_output))) + 
        geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
        ggtitle("Locus Phylogenetic Distance between Mapped Reads and Reference") + ylab("Count")

    tiff(file=fn_dist_tiff, units="px", width=2880, height=1800)
    print(plot + theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, size=50),
                    plot.margin = margin(1.25, 1.25, 1.25, 1.25, "cm"),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(size=30),
                    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                    axis.text.y = element_text(size=30),
                    axis.title.y = element_text(size=40, margin=margin(t=0, r=20, b=0, l=0)),
                    legend.position = "none"))
    dev.off()
}
```

```{r, out.width="100%", include=is_check_summary_individual}
print(plot + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
                   plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, "cm")))
```

## Correlation analysis on locus phylogenetic distances
```{r summary-correlation}
# create doSNOW cluster
nwcl <- makeCluster(params$thread)
doSNOW::registerDoSNOW(nwcl)

# set the pivot species
focal_sp <- params$focal_species
if (is.null(focal_sp) || focal_sp=="") {
    focal_sp <- sample(ls_refseq, 1)
}

readr::write_lines(paste("Calculating pairwise distance against ", focal_sp), file=fn_log, append=T)

# iterate over loci
df_output <- foreach (locus = ls_locus, .combine='rbind') %dopar% {
    library(ggplot2)

    # output variables
    read_out <- data.table::data.table(locus=character(), read=character(),
                                       lm_r2=numeric(), lm_slope=numeric(), lm_p=numeric(),
                                       spearman_rho=numeric(), spearman_p=numeric(),
                                       lm_r2_noout=numeric(), lm_slope_noout=numeric(), lm_p_noout=numeric(),
                                       spearman_rho_noout=numeric(), spearman_p_noout=numeric())

    # read trees
    tre_original <- ape::read.tree(file.path(params$dir_genes_alignment, locus, paste0(locus, ".treefile")))
    tre_original_tips <- tre_original$tip.label

    # update list of mapped reads
    ls_prefix_available <- ls_prefix[ls_prefix %in% tre_original_tips]
    ls_shortreads_available <- sapply(ls_prefix_available, function(x) {
        unlist(strsplit(x, split="--"))[1]
    })
    ls_shortreads_available <- unique(ls_shortreads_available)

    # calculate phylogenetic distance
    distance_tre <- ape::cophenetic.phylo(tre_original)

    # iterate over short reads
    for (read in ls_shortreads_available) {
        # initiate variables
        dir_temp_fig <- file.path(dir_check_summary_correlation, read)

        # temporary data.table
        temp_df_dist <- data.table::data.table(read=character(), ref=character(), ref_dist=numeric(), read_dist=numeric(), grouping=character())

        # extract available available reference sequences
        ls_refseq_available <- grep(paste0("^",read,"--"), tre_original_tips, value=T)
        ls_refseq_available <- sapply(ls_refseq_available, function(x) {
            unlist(strsplit(x, split="--"))[2]
        })

        # iterate over reference sequence
        for (ref in ls_refseq_available) {
            # check if prefix if filtered out by TreeShrink
            prefix <- paste0(read, "--", ref)

            # calculate distance for reference
            ref_dist <- distance_tre[rownames(distance_tre)==focal_sp, colnames(distance_tre)==ref]

            # calculate distance for short reads
            read_dist <- distance_tre[rownames(distance_tre)==focal_sp, colnames(distance_tre)==prefix]

            # update data.frame
            temp_df_dist <- rbind(temp_df_dist, data.table::data.table(read=read,
                                                                       ref=ref,
                                                                       ref_dist=ref_dist,
                                                                       read_dist=read_dist,
                                                                       grouping=df_refs$grouping[df_refs$species==ref]
                                                                       ))
        }

        # check if all values are NULL or NAs
        if (f_all_null_or_na(temp_df_dist$ref_dist) || f_all_null_or_na(temp_df_dist$read_dist)) {
            next
        }

        # subset data.frame
        temp_df_dist_noout <- temp_df_dist[!temp_df_dist$grouping %in% params$outgroup,]

        # run linear model with outgroup
        lm <- lm(read_dist~ref_dist, data=temp_df_dist)
        lm_statistics <- f_extract_summary_lm(lm)
        sp_statistics <- f_spearman_test(temp_df_dist$read_dist, temp_df_dist$ref_dist)

        # visualisation
        fn_locus_tiff <- file.path(dir_temp_fig, paste0(locus, ".tiff"))

        plot <- ggplot(temp_df_dist, aes(x=ref_dist, y=read_dist)) +
            geom_point(aes(size=20, color=grouping)) +
            geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype=3, aes(linewidth=3)) +
            stat_smooth(geom='line', aes(x=ref_dist, y=read_dist, linewidth=3), linetype=1, method='lm', formula=y~x, color="black", alpha=0.5)

        # linear model without outgroup
        lm_statistics_noout <- list(rsquared=NULL, slope=NULL, pvalue=NULL)
        sp_statistics_noout <- list(rho=NULL, pvalue=NULL)

        if (nrow(temp_df_dist_noout) > 0 && !f_all_null_or_na(temp_df_dist_noout$ref_dist) && !f_all_null_or_na(temp_df_dist_noout$read_dist)) {
            # run linear model without outgroup
            lm_noout <- lm(read_dist~ref_dist, data=temp_df_dist_noout)
            lm_statistics_noout <- f_extract_summary_lm(lm_noout)
            sp_statistics_noout <- f_spearman_test(temp_df_dist_noout$read_dist, temp_df_dist_noout$ref_dist)

            plot <- plot + stat_smooth(data=temp_df_dist_noout, geom='line', aes(x=ref_dist, y=read_dist, linewidth=3), linetype=2, method='lm', formula=y~x, color="red", alpha=0.5)
        }

        # update data.frame
        read_out <- rbind(read_out, data.table::data.table(locus=locus,
                                                           read=read,
                                                           lm_r2=lm_statistics$rsquared,
                                                           lm_slope=lm_statistics$slope,
                                                           lm_p=lm_statistics$pvalue,
                                                           spearman_rho=sp_statistics$rho,
                                                           spearman_p=sp_statistics$pvalue,
                                                           lm_r2_noout=lm_statistics_noout$rsquared,
                                                           lm_slope_noout=lm_statistics_noout$slope,
                                                           lm_p_noout=lm_statistics_noout$pvalue,
                                                           spearman_rho_noout=sp_statistics_noout$rho,
                                                           spearman_p_noout=sp_statistics_noout$pvalue
                                                           ))
        
        # update plot
        plot <- plot + ggtitle(paste(locus, "Phylogenetic Distances")) +
            xlab("Reference Distance") + ylab("Mapped Reads Distance") +
            guides(color=guide_legend(title="Taxonomy"), size="none", linewidth="none") +
            theme(
                plot.title=element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 50),
                plot.margin=margin(1.25, 1.25, 1.25, 1.25, "cm"),
                axis.title.x=element_text(size = 40, margin = margin(t=20, r=0, b=0, l=0)),
                axis.title.y=element_text(size = 40, margin = margin(t=0, r=20, b=0, l=0)),
                axis.text.y=element_text(size=30),
                axis.text.x=element_text(size=30),
                legend.title=element_text(size=15),
                legend.text=element_text(size=15),
                legend.key.size=unit(1,"cm"),
                strip.text=element_text(size = 30)
            )

        # save the plot
        tiff(file=fn_locus_tiff, units="px", width=1400, height=700)
        print(plot)
        dev.off()
    }

    return(read_out)
}

stopCluster(nwcl)

# save the data.frame
data.table::fwrite(df_output, file=fn_cor_summary, sep="\t", quote=F, row.names=F)
```
